record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: For the global case with E ≠ K, prove that the global period integral P is nonzero exactly when every local Hom-space Hom_{U(V_v)}(Π_v, ω_{V_v,ψ,μ_v}) is nonzero and the twisted Asai central value L(1/2, Π, As_{L/E} × μ^{-1}) is nonzero, and prove that a nonzero central value forces the existence of an n-dimensional skew-Hermitian space V over E for which the global period integral is nonzero.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 11.1. The global period integral P is nonzero if and only if ... (a) For all places v of F, HomU(Vv)(Πv, ωVv,ψ,µv) 6= 0. (b) the twisted Asai automorphic L-function satisfies: L(1/2, Π, AsL/E × µ−1) 6= 0. Further, if L(1/2, Π, AsL/E × µ−1) 6= 0, then there exists a skew-Hermitian space V of dimension n over E such that the global period integral P is nonzero.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let F be a number field and let E/F be a quadratic extension with associated quadratic character η_{E/F}. Let L be another quadratic étale F-algebra distinct from E, set K = L ⊗_F E (a quadratic étale E-algebra), and write μ for a Hecke character of L^× (lifted to a character of A_L^×) whose restriction to A_F^× equals η_{E/F}. Let V be an n-dimensional skew-Hermitian space over E, with associated unitary group U(V), and consider the Weil representation ω_{V,ψ,μ} of U(V) attached to a non-trivial additive character ψ of A_F/F and the splitting character μ. Let Π be an irreducible cuspidal automorphic representation of U_n(K)(A_F) (the unitary group of an n-dimensional Hermitian/skew-Hermitian space over K with respect to K/E), and define the global period integral

  P(φ, θ) = ∫_{[U(V)]} φ(g) · θ(g) dg,    φ ∈ Π,  θ ∈ ω_{V,ψ,μ},

where [U(V)] = U(V)(F)\U(V)(A_F).

Prove the following two statements:

(i) The period integral P is not identically zero on Π ⊗ ω_{V,ψ,μ} if and only if both
    (a) for every place v of F, Hom_{U(V_v)}(Π_v, ω_{V_v,ψ_v,μ_v}) ≠ 0, and
    (b) the twisted Asai central L-value satisfies L(1/2, Π, As_{L/E} × μ^{-1}) ≠ 0.

(ii) If L(1/2, Π, As_{L/E} × μ^{-1}) ≠ 0, then there exists some n-dimensional skew-Hermitian space V over E such that the period integral P is not identically zero on Π ⊗ ω_{V,ψ,μ}.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture remains generally open, but substantial progress has been made. A recent preprint (Sept. 2025) announces a proof of the twisted GGP conjecture for Asai L-functions in arbitrary dimension under certain local assumptions and allowing ramification. Earlier work established the conjecture for certain tempered L-packets and for unramified quadratic extensions. A fully unconditional proof in all cases does not appear to be available.

status_evidence.title: Central values of Asai L-functions and twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: We prove the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad (GGP) conjecture on Asai L-functions, in any dimension under some local assumptions, allowing ramifications of number fields.
status_evidence.claim: Proves the conjecture in arbitrary dimension under local hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for unramified quadratic extensions
status_evidence.snippet: Twisted GGP for unramified quadratic extensions.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier partial result in the unramified setting.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for certain tempered L-packets
status_evidence.snippet: Twisted GGP for certain tempered L-packets via theta correspondence.
status_evidence.claim: Partial result for certain tempered packets.
